notes: 原卷未收录旧题库开头的新闻导语及两处额外背景，已删去；依原卷恢复8段。
source.method: 逐段对照用户提供的原卷；保留原卷有效英文，修复旧题库的漏句、多句及录入错误后逐句编辑中文。

paragraphs.en: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be, Diane Coyle, an economist at Cambridge University, argues that the digital economy requires new ways of thinking about progress. “Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past,” she writes. “An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable.”

sentences.en: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be, Diane Coyle, an economist at Cambridge University, argues that the digital economy requires new ways of thinking about progress.

chunks.en: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be,
chunks.zh: 在新书《齿轮与怪物：经济学是什么，又应当是什么》中，
剑桥大学的一位经济学家，

chunks.en: requires new ways of thinking about progress.
chunks.zh: 要求我们用新的方式思考进步。

sentences.reorder: 将同位语身份放到人名前；In her new book 交代观点来源；that 后才是核心判断。
sentences.translation: 剑桥大学经济学家黛安娜·科伊尔在新书《齿轮与怪物：经济学是什么，又应当是什么》中提出，数字经济要求我们用新的方式思考进步。

phrases.meaning: 《Cogs and Monsters》（文中讨论经济学的一本书）

sentences.en: “Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past,” she writes.

chunks.en: “Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better,
chunks.zh: “不管我们如何理解经济增长、生活改善，

chunks.en: will have to be more evenly shared
chunks.zh: 都必须得到更公平的分享，

sentences.reorder: 把 she writes 放前；whatever 是让步，比较对象是近些年的收益分配状况。
sentences.translation: 她写道：“不管我们如何理解经济增长和生活改善，其收益都必须比近些年分配得更公平。”

sentences.en: “An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable.”

chunks.en: “An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers,
chunks.zh: “一种由科技百万富翁、亿万富翁和零工劳动者组成的经济，

chunks.en: with middle-income jobs undercut by automation,
chunks.zh: 其中中等收入工作被自动化削弱，

sentences.reorder: with 补充中间层岗位受挤压的状态；主干 economy...will not 要连起来。
sentences.translation: “如果一种经济只有科技百万富翁、亿万富翁和零工劳动者，而中等收入工作不断受到自动化冲击，这在政治上将难以持续。”

words.meaning: 可持续的；能够长期维持的

paragraphs.en: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle. But people can't be expected to embrace the changes if they're not seeing the benefits—if they're just seeing good jobs being destroyed.

sentences.en: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle.

chunks.en: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people
chunks.zh: 提高生活水平，让更多人更加富足，

chunks.en: will require greater use of digital technologies
chunks.zh: 需要更广泛地采用数字技术，

chunks.en: to boost productivity in various sectors,
chunks.zh: 以提高各行业的生产率，

sentences.reorder: 先译说话人；动名词并列作主语，to boost 表目的，including 举行业例子。
sentences.translation: 科伊尔说，要提高生活水平、让更多人更加富足，就需要在医疗、建筑等行业更广泛地采用数字技术，提高生产率。

sentences.en: But people can't be expected to embrace the changes if they're not seeing the benefits—if they're just seeing good jobs being destroyed.

chunks.en: if they're not seeing the benefits—
if they're just seeing good jobs being destroyed.
chunks.zh: 如果他们看到的只是好工作被摧毁。

sentences.reorder: 两个 if 的条件放在结果“不能指望接受”前，破折号后具体解释看不到好处。
sentences.translation: 但如果人们看不到好处，看到的只是好工作消失，就不能指望他们接受这些变化。

paragraphs.en: In a recent interview, Coyle said she fears that tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI. “We're talking about disruption,” she says. “These are transformative technologies that change the ways we spend our time every day, that change business models that succeed.” To make such “tremendous changes,” she adds, you need social buy-in.

sentences.en: In a recent interview, Coyle said she fears that tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI.

chunks.en: that tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock
chunks.zh: 科技造成的不平等问题可能成为障碍，
阻碍人工智能的部署应用。

sentences.reorder: 把 to deploying 的修饰接成 roadblock 的对象；保留 fears/could 的担忧与可能性。
sentences.translation: 在最近一次采访中，科伊尔表示，她担心科技造成的不平等问题可能阻碍人工智能的部署应用。

sentences.reorder: 将说话人放到引语前，disruption 指技术改变经济结构。
sentences.translation: 她说：“我们谈的是颠覆性变化。”

words.meaning: 颠覆性变化；对既有模式的冲击

sentences.en: “These are transformative technologies that change the ways we spend our time every day, that change business models that succeed.”

chunks.en: we spend our time every day,
chunks.zh: 即我们每天如何使用时间，

sentences.reorder: 两个 that 并列说明技术的作用；ways 后省略关系词，最后 that 修饰商业模式。
sentences.translation: “这些是变革性技术，会改变我们每天使用时间的方式，也会改变什么样的商业模式能够成功。”

sentences.en: To make such “tremendous changes,” she adds, you need social buy-in.

chunks.zh: 要作出这样的“巨大改变”，

sentences.reorder: 把 she adds 放前；To make 说明社会认同对应的目标，不是购买社会。
sentences.translation: 她补充说，要作出这样的“巨大改变”，就需要获得社会认同。

paragraphs.en: Instead, says Coyle, resentment is simmering among many as the benefits are perceived to go to elites in a handful of prosperous cities.

sentences.en: Instead, says Coyle, resentment is simmering among many as the benefits are perceived to go to elites in a handful of prosperous cities.

chunks.zh: 许多人的不满正在酝酿，

chunks.en: as the benefits are perceived to go
chunks.zh: 因为人们认为收益流向了，

chunks.en: in a handful of prosperous cities.
chunks.zh: 在少数几个繁荣城市里的精英群体。

sentences.reorder: 先把 as 的原因说清；in 的地点修饰 elites；simmering 为不满暗中积聚的比喻。
sentences.translation: 科伊尔说，现实恰恰相反：人们认为收益都流向少数繁荣城市的精英群体，因此许多人的不满正在酝酿。

words.meaning: 掌握优势资源的精英群体

paragraphs.en: According to the Brookings Institution, a short list of eight American cities that included San Francisco, San Jose, Boston, and Seattle had roughly 38% of all tech jobs by 2019. New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.

sentences.en: According to the Brookings Institution, a short list of eight American cities that included San Francisco, San Jose, Boston, and Seattle had roughly 38% of all tech jobs by 2019.

chunks.zh: 根据布鲁金斯学会的数据，

chunks.en: a short list of eight American cities
that included San Francisco, San Jose, Boston, and Seattle
chunks.zh: 包括旧金山、圣何塞、波士顿和西雅图，

chunks.en: had roughly 38% of all tech jobs

sentences.reorder: 把截至2019年放前；that 列出八城中的例子，roughly 修饰38%而非八城。
sentences.translation: 布鲁金斯学会的数据显示，截至2019年，仅旧金山、圣何塞、波士顿、西雅图等八座美国城市，就集中了约38%的科技岗位。

sentences.en: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.

chunks.en: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated:
chunks.zh: 新的人工智能技术尤为集中：

chunks.en: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate
chunks.zh: 布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，

chunks.en: account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
chunks.zh: 就占据美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。

sentences.reorder: 冒号后用统计解释集中程度；account for 为占比，不是解释原因。
sentences.translation: 新的人工智能技术分布尤为集中：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15座城市就占据美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。

paragraphs.en: The dominance of a few cities in the invention and commercialization of AI means that geographical disparities in wealth will continue to soar. Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow.

sentences.en: The dominance of a few cities in the invention and commercialization of AI means that geographical disparities in wealth will continue to soar.

chunks.en: The dominance of a few cities
in the invention and commercialization of AI
chunks.zh: 在人工智能发明和商业化方面，

chunks.en: geographical disparities in wealth will continue to soar.
chunks.zh: 地区间的财富差距将继续扩大。

sentences.reorder: 把 in 的领域提前修饰主导地位；that 后才是集中带来的后果。
sentences.translation: 少数城市在人工智能发明和商业化方面占据主导地位，意味着地区间的财富差距将继续扩大。

sentences.en: Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow.

chunks.en: Not only will this foster political and social unrest,
chunks.zh: 这不仅会滋生政治和社会动荡，

chunks.en: hold back the sorts of AI technologies
chunks.zh: 阻碍某些人工智能技术，

chunks.en: needed for regional economies to grow.
chunks.zh: 那些地区经济发展所需要的技术。

sentences.reorder: 倒装 Not only will 还原顺序；将 needed 修饰放到技术前；as Coyle suggests 为插入来源。
sentences.translation: 这不仅会滋生政治和社会动荡，还可能如科伊尔所说，阻碍地区经济发展所需的那些人工智能技术。

paragraphs.en: Part of the solution could lie in somehow loosening the stranglehold that Big Tech has on defining the AI agenda. That will likely take increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants.

sentences.en: Part of the solution could lie in somehow loosening the stranglehold that Big Tech has on defining the AI agenda.

chunks.en: Part of the solution could lie
chunks.zh: 部分解决办法可能在于，
设法松动这种牢牢的控制，
科技巨头所拥有的控制，
针对人工智能议程的制定。

sentences.reorder: 把 that 与 on 两个修饰合成“科技巨头对……的牢牢控制”，再接“松动”。
sentences.translation: 部分解决办法可能在于，设法减弱科技巨头对人工智能议程制定的牢牢控制。

sentences.en: That will likely take increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants.

chunks.zh: 不依赖科技巨头的研究。

sentences.reorder: 把 independent 的修饰放到研究前，That 回指松动科技巨头控制。
sentences.translation: 这很可能需要增加联邦资金，支持独立于科技巨头的研究。

paragraphs.en: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.

sentences.en: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.

chunks.zh: 拓宽我们对数字技术的想象，
构想这样的人工智能技术，

chunks.en: but expand opportunities in the sectors
chunks.zh: 还在相关行业扩大机会，

chunks.en: that different parts of the country care most about,
chunks.zh: 那些全国不同地区最关心的行业，

chunks.en: like health care, education, and manufacturing.

sentences.reorder: 将 that different parts 的修饰放到 sectors 前；not simply...but 并列技术的两种作用；两个 to 是应对方式和目标。
sentences.translation: 更直接的应对办法是拓宽对数字技术的想象，构想不只是取代工作、还能在各地区最关心的行业——如医疗、教育和制造业——扩大机会的人工智能技术。
